Usage: seek search <query> [flags]

Search across collections

Arguments:
  <query>    Search query

Flags:
  -h, --help                 Show context-sensitive help.
      --version              Show version and exit.

      --lex                  BM25 full-text search only
      --vec                  Vector semantic search only
  -l, --limit=10             Max results
      --collection=STRING    Filter by collection name
      --lang=STRING          Filter code documents by programming language (e.g.
                             go, python, typescript)
      --path=STRING          Filter by path pattern (GLOB)
  -C, --context=0            Number of surrounding chunks before and after to
                             expand context
      --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON instead of
                             human-formatted output

Advanced
  --repo=STRING            Filter by repository or collection name (alias for
                           --collection)
  --doc-type=STRING        Filter by document type (markdown, claude, codex,
                           images, pdf, documents, parser, code)
  --after=STRING           Filter documents after this date (RFC3339)
  --before=STRING          Filter documents before this date (RFC3339)
  --chunk-type=STRING      Filter by chunk type (text, image)
  --workspace=STRING       Filter parser collections by workspace directory
                           (fast field)
  --field=FIELD,...        Filter by fast field name:value (e.g.
                           topics:concurrency, entities:ORG:OpenAI, language:en,
                           repo:myproject)
  --aggs=AGGS,...          Aggregations to run (e.g., type:terms,
                           created_at:histogram:month)
  --query-mode=""          Query mode: raw or parsed
  --sort-by=STRING         Sort results by field (e.g., created_at, line_count)
  --sort-order="desc"      Sort order: asc or desc
  --analyze                Analyze query text (tokenize, stem) and exit
  --analyze-lang=STRING    Language for analysis (en, tr); defaults to
                           search.analyze_lang in config, then en
  --autocomplete           Show autocomplete suggestions for the query prefix
  --autocomplete-max=10    Max autocomplete suggestions
